_comment: Homepage copy. headline and lede are what HomeContent.astro prerenders for crawlers and first paint; apps/site/scripts/verify-build.mjs checks the prerendered h1 against headline. The headline* and pricingFacts keys are still read by apps/worker/web/Landing.tsx and ChannelCycle.tsx until the landing rebuild replaces them.
headline: Mark it up. We’ll knock it out.
lede: Click anywhere on your new site and tell us what needs fixing. Every note lands on your team’s list, and you watch each one get checked off.
pricingFacts: Markup.io discontinued its free tier in 2025 and moved Pro to $79/month. BugHerd, Marker.io and Feedbucket have no permanent free plan at all, only trials.
